evidence.quotation: FLIP: Select 1 monster on the field and return it to its owner's hand.
evidence.historicalApplicability: Current reference text; original 2002 LOB print recorded separately. Not claiming historical printed wording.

evidence.quotation: Flip Effects, other Trigger Effects that activate when a monster is flipped face-up, and many effects that activate “after damage calculation” activate here and form a Chain if necessary.
evidence.historicalApplicability: Goat Substep 5; FLIP resolves after battle destruction determination and before End of Damage Step movement.

evidence.quotation: If you need to select a monster for the Flip effect to target, you cannot target a monster that has already been destroyed during damage calculation.
evidence.historicalApplicability: Baseline targeting exclusion cross-checked against Goat substep order; not a source for modern timing overrides.

notes: Mandatory single-target FLIP, either side and face-down monsters eligible except battle-destroyed monsters. Flip Summon activates immediately; attack flip waits until after calculation.
